name: What percentage of San Diego car accident fatalities are pedestrians or bicyclists?

mainEntity.name: What percentage of San Diego car accident fatalities are pedestrians or bicyclists?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the latest year, 94 of 284 fatalities from San Diego crashes were pedestrians and 10 were bicyclists, making up more than one-third of traffic deaths.seriousaccidents​
